summary: Inversion FVG model with graded setups, sweeps, equal highs and lows, sessions, HTF FVGs, SMT, NWOGs, delta coloring and a checklist.
overview: This community script builds setups around inversion fair value gaps (IFVGs): gaps that price closes through and that then act from the other side. Each setup gets a grade, entry markers, a stop, break-even and two targets, with an optional contract-size suggestion from a risk amount.

Around the setups it can draw liquidity sweeps, relative equal highs and lows, session highs and lows and boxes, previous day and week levels, midnight, 8:30 and 9:30 opens, higher-timeframe FVGs, SMT divergences, new week opening gaps, per-candle value area boxes, a small volume profile, delta candle colors and a checklist table.
how: Gaps are detected in series or one by one, with an ATR filter (0.1 by default). Filters can require a liquidity sweep, delivery from a higher-timeframe PD array, a macro time window, or that break-even was not breached. Gaps of 7 to 15 candles can be allowed.
Swing size for sweeps can follow the chart timeframe or be set by you. SMT uses a correlated symbol, automatic or manual, across several timeframes.
The volume tools estimate buy and sell imbalance per candle from lower-timeframe data.
use: Use the grade and checklist to see which filters a setup meets.
Some traders watch IFVGs that form right after a sweep of a session or daily level.
Use equal highs and lows as reference pools where stops may cluster.
Turn modules on one at a time to learn what each adds.
alerts: Alerts: the script sends its own alert messages, and members can create an alert on them from the chart's alert dialog; alerts from indicators run while ZoroCharts is open in the browser.
notes: Results shown on the chart follow the script's own rules; Hide Losing Setups changes what you see, not what happened.
SMT and HTF tools need extra data requests and can slow loading.
Session times follow New York time.
